skill.summary: Create 60-90 second portfolio and service overview videos showcasing wedding planners' style, vendor network, and seamless day-of execution for engaged couples.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Wedding Planner Video skill.
- Enables wedding planners to create portfolio and full-service planning videos.
- Supports multiple video types: style showcase, service overview, real wedding feature, client testimonial, and vendor/venue partnership features.
- Guides users through gathering key planner information (style, market, budget, services, vendor relationships).
- Generates 60–90 second scripts and suggests relevant b-roll for impactful, story-driven wedding planning videos.
